title: Using a NanoZoomer S20 to Digitize Natural History Collections
author: Ingrid Romero
materials: If image quality is acceptable, click “Accept”.
After reinserting the cassette, select “Scan Settings”.

steps.title: Prepare Slides and Cassette
steps.instruction: Load the slides into the cassette with coverslips facing up and labels facing outward. This process takes approximately five minutes for pre-organized slides.

steps.title: Initialize NanoZoomer and Load Cassette
steps.instruction: Power on the NanoZoomer (NZ) and prepare the hardware for cassette insertion.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Cassette Access' in the software.
Wait for the NZ to make a noise indicating the door can be opened.
Extract the cassette by tilting it outward at approximately 30°.
Insert the cassette into the NZ and close the door.
Click 'OK' in the NZAcquire software.

steps.title: Configure Scanning Mode
steps.instruction: Set the scanner to Semi Automatic mode to allow for manual review and adjustment of heterogeneous Natural History Collection samples.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Batch Scan'.
If 'Batch Type' is set to 'Fully Automatic', change it to 'Semi Automatic'.

steps.title: Initialize Sample View
steps.instruction: Access the sample list and capture initial images.

substeps.instruction: Click 'List View'.
Click the white triangle (yellow arrow) to display samples in the cassette.
Capture a macro image by clicking the camera icon 'Taking a slide image'.
Click 'Cassette information' in the bottom-right of the screen.

steps.title: Define Scan Profile
steps.instruction: Create or edit a scan profile to set default parameters for the batch.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Scan Profile'.
Choose an existing profile (click 'Edit') or create a new one (click 'New').
Click 'Scan Profile Name' to rename the profile if necessary.
Click 'Barcode' and drag the green border to define the label area (do not click 'Apply' yet).
Select 'Scan Area' and click/drag on the sample region to define the blue scan area.
Set 'Focus Point Numbers' (recommended 5 or 9 points per scan area).
Configure 'Split tissue' settings (usually 5 mm) to divide large scan areas into subregions for better focus.

steps.title: Configure Scan Conditions
steps.instruction: Set the magnification and Z-stack parameters for 3D structure capture.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Scan Condition'.
Choose the Lens: 20X (0.46 μm/pixel) for insects, wood, and coal ball peels, or 40X (0.23 μm/pixel) for microfossils (pollen, diatoms, radiolarians).
Configure Z-Stack: Define the number of layers (odd number from 1 to 301) and the distance between layers (1 to 150 µm).
Use the 'Offset' option to move the middle focal plane if needed.
If using 'Custom' Z-stack settings, click 'Accept' to save changes.
Click 'Apply' to save the completed profile.

steps.title: Import Sample Names
steps.instruction: Assign names to the slides in the cassette.

substeps.instruction: If slides lack QR/barcodes, prepare a .txt or .csv file with sample names in order (no titles or spaces).
Click 'Import' to add names from the file.
Select 'Overwrite' when the pop-up message appears.
Alternatively, add names manually in the numbered area or during slide review.

steps.title: Review and Refine Individual Slides
steps.instruction: Manually verify the scan area and focus for each slide before final capture.

substeps.instruction: Select 'Slide View' and click through each slide image on the left.
To modify the scan area: Select 'Sample Area' -> 'remove', then redraw the area by clicking and dragging.
To modify focus: Select 'Focus' -> 'Remove', then click the scan area to add new focal points, or select 'Auto' if the scan area was modified.

steps.title: Execute Scanning
steps.instruction: Start the automated scanning process and monitor progress.

substeps.instruction: Click 'Accept' to start scanning.
Monitor the focal point quality check: light green (in focus), dark green (possibly in focus), red (out of focus).
If autofocus fails: Go to 'Scan Settings' -> 'Focus' -> 'Remove', manually add focus points, and select 'Accept'.
Monitor progress via the symbols: hourglass (waiting), yellow/green/red (scanned).

steps.title: Post-Scan Review and Extraction
steps.instruction: Verify the resulting images and remove the slides.

substeps.instruction: Select 'View slide' after each sample finishes to review the final image.
Select 'Back to Scan Result' then 'Scan Settings' to continue scanning other samples.
Once finished, select 'Cassette Access' and extract the cassette (tilt outward 30°).
